title: Item Dithering
description: Adds dithering to hand items for cleaner view. Compatible with any shaders!

# 💬 Description
**Item Dithering** — Mod that adds dithering to items in your hands to make your first person view more clear:

![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d983b4f273ef3861ee2cd0328efa2209b60c10cf_0.webp)

# 🌟 Shaders Compatible
Don't worry, this mod works with all shaders, including those from your resource packs or Iris shaders! You don't need to do anything — just enable them, and it will work.

[**BSL Shaders**](https://modrinth.com/shader/bsl-shaders) Enabled:

![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/044e285519a2c4d2e8454d6e0f2315cec36d9217_0.webp)

# ⚙️ Configuration Screen
Here you can easily configure effect behaviour and choose which items will have it!
